method: We kept zero-ozone ENERGY STAR air purifiers certified as connected-capable (network control) and compared those with the highest smoke CADR, weighing smoke CADR and the five-year electricity cost (certified yearly energy use x current EIA U.S. average residential price x 5). Smoke CADR carries 80% of the score and five-year cost 20%, as on the small-rooms page.
name: Best smart Wi-Fi air purifiers, ranked by certified data
scoring: each value scored against the best on the page (best = 1), times its weight; total out of 100

excluded.why: conservative choice: only units that report 0 ppb ozone in certification; UL's zero-ozone test (UL 2998) cannot quantify low readings, so this also drops units whose small non-zero reports are not reliably different from 0

selection.label: Smoke CADR
selection.merge: listings with identical certified values on all 23 reported fields
